A versatile, everyday choice, the Tuscan Court Shoe is an ode to the old-school kicks Todd’s known and loved over the years. A menswear staple, “court shoes” were originally designed for wearing on tennis or basketball courts (hence the name), but have become ubiquitous on feet everywhere thanks to their sporty look. That timeless silhouette gets an upgrade here with luxe leather uppers and Vachetta leather accents that play against the shoe’s clean lines. Our deconstructed take pairs just as well with light-wash denim and a tee as it does with chinos and a button-down. Premium details include brogue-style stitching and a suede “mudguard” before the vamp for a little extra protection. The whole affair is comfortably grounded in a cork footbed and a solid rubber EVA sole.

p-kamakurashirts-9252381163747.d:
A truly exceptional shirt crafted from the legendary “phantom cotton.”
Of all the cotton produced across 90 countries worldwide, less than 8% is considered premium cotton. Among them, the exceptionally rare SUVIN GOLD stands apart — often referred to as the “phantom cotton.”
Accounting for only 0.003% of the world’s total cotton production, its existence remains little known even within the textile industry itself. Kamakura Shirts has long pursued this extraordinary cotton for its refined luster and remarkably smooth touch — qualities we invite you to experience firsthand.
What is SUVIN GOLD?
• An extra-long staple cotton carefully cultivated in designated farms in South India.
• The title “GOLD” is reserved exclusively for the first and second harvests, where the cotton plants have fully absorbed the richness of the soil.
• Renowned for its soft, supple texture, elegant sheen, and beautifully vivid color expression.
Fabric
• Luxuriously crafted using SUVIN GOLD, spun into an ultra-fine 150-count yarn.
• Its exceptionally long and uniform fibers create both rich color depth and a refined natural luster.
